item.title: Pabna BNP leader shot dead
item.description: A BNP leader has been shot dead in Pabna's Ishwardi Upazila.The incident took place around 10am on Wednes-day in the Kamalpur area of Lakshmikunda Union, said Ishwardi Police Station chief (OC) Md Mominuz-zaman.The victim, 65-year-old Biru Molla, was the convenor of the Lakshmikunda Union unit of the BNP.Jahurul Molla, 55, who has been accused over the killing, is Biru's cousin.According to Biru's son Rajib Molla's complaint, Jahurul had encroached on some of their brick kilns. item.title: Israel approves natural gas deal with Egypt, Netanyahu says
item.description: Israel has approved a deal that will supply natural gas to Egypt, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said on Wednesday, describing it as the country's largest-ever gas deal.Israel signed the export agreement in August with Chevron and its partners, NewMed NWMDp.TA and Ratio, to supply up to $35 billion of gas to Egypt from the Leviathan natural gas field."I have today approved the largest gas deal in Israel's history. item.title: Mbappe's brace helps Real Madrid to narrow cup win over 3rd-tier Talavera
item.description: Kylian Mbappe scored twice and Real Madrid beat third-division club Talavera 3-2 in the round of 32 of the Copa del Rey on Wednesday.Mbappe converted a 41st-minute penalty and sealed the victory late in the second half with a shot from outside the area for his 10th goal in his last six matches in all competitions with Madrid. item.title: Indian Visa Centre in Dhaka reopens
item.description: The Indian Visa Application Centre (IVAC) in Dhaka has been operational after being temporarily closed due to security concerns.The Indian High Commission confirmed the development on Thursday (December 18) morning, saying visa services at the centre resumed as normal.Earlier on Wednesday, a platform named 'July Unity' announced a 'March to Indian High Commission' programme under its banner. Then the Indian Visa Application Centre closed at 2PM in view of the ongoing security situation.TFIndian

item.title: Crimes against humanity: Quader, six others chargedsheeted

item.title: NCP leader's hanging body recovered from hostel
item.description: Police on Thursday morning recovered the hanging body of a student named Jannat Ara Rumi from a female hostel near Hazaribagh Zigatola kacha bazar.The body was sent to Dhaka Medical College Hospital (DMCH) morgue.Confirming the recovery news, Hazaribagh Police Station OC Saiful Islam informed media that the deceased was involved in NCP's political activities.Police primarily suspect that Rumi might have committed suicide as she was under family pressure.TF
